text_blocks.snippet: Losartan commonly causes mild side effects like dizziness, fatigue, and upper respiratory infections that often improve as your body adjusts.
snippet_highlighted_words: dizziness, fatigue, and upper respiratory infections

list.snippet: Dizziness or lightheadedness from lowered blood pressure
Upper respiratory infections or a stuffy nose
Mild digestive upset like nausea, diarrhea, or indigestion
High potassium levels (hyperkalemia) which can cause muscle weakness or irregular heartbeats
Severely low blood pressure leading to fainting
Allergic reactions and angioedema causing swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat
Birth defects, meaning you should not take losartan if you are pregnant
